Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this — we're finalising setup on our side for Redwood and hit a couple of small questions before we upload documents to your portal: 

- Which exact tax / company proofs do you need for UK entities so you can accept invoices under reverse-charge? (VAT cert, company extract, statement of tax residency?)
- Do you need a signed onboarding form from our side, or is a portal upload sufficient?
- For POs: should we send invoices with VAT line = 0 and note "reverse charge applied"? Or do you prefer us to invoice gross and let you net it?

We can attach our VAT registration and company extract — will upload once we confirm the expected filenames/fields.

Best,
André

Nutriva Ltd

Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding - VAT evidence & invoice processing question

Hi André — thanks for the clear questions. Quick answers and next steps below. I'm copying Procurement (Karthik) and Finance/AP (Naomi) so we can close this loop.

Required documentation (upload to vendor portal link below):
- VAT registration certificate (official PDF) — required for reverse-charge treatment
- Company extract / registration (recent) — helps legal & tax team verify legal name
- Beneficial owner / authorised signatory ID (passport/ID scan) — if not already in our KYC
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached Excel) — please fill the highlighted tabs (bank details, tax IDs, contact persons)

Invoice guidance (finance preference):
- Preferred: Invoice the PO net with VAT field zero and include the standard reverse-charge wording on the invoice (see sample invoice attached).
- Alternative: Invoice gross but include separate VAT line; our AP will net during processing — this may delay payment by 2–3 days while we reconcile.

PO wiring / payment notes:
- Please ensure bank account name on the onboarding form matches the company extract exactly.
- For international GBP payouts we use our Treasury partner; include IBAN/SWIFT and reason codes in the portal fields.

Next actions for Nutriva:
1) Fill and upload the attached "redwood-vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx" (complete bank + tax tabs).
2) Upload VAT cert + company extract to the vendor portal: https://vendors.redwood.example.com/upload/PO-2026-0789
3) Attach an invoice sample with your preferred invoice formatting (net vs gross).

Attachments: redwood-vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx, invoice-sample-reverse-charge.pdf

I'll track this on our side — Karthik, Naomi, if there are additional gating items please flag.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding - VAT evidence & invoice processing question

Hi André — quick procurement confirmation:
- We will keep the PO amount as issued (gross amount) in our ERP. AP will record the VAT treatment separately when processing the invoice.
- Preferred supplier behavior is to invoice net with the phrase: "Reverse charge - customer to account for VAT under Article 194 (or local equivalent)." That avoids a reconciliation step for you.

Naomi — can you confirm whether AP wants any special PO notes or a sub-ledger flag so that Nutriva invoices are paid on net terms without PO adjustments? If legal/tax needs a clause added to the supplier agreement to formalize reverse-charge, please advise.

André — once Naomi confirms, we'll push the vendor to active and schedule the first payment run.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Procurement (EMEA)
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Andre Mueller <andre.mueller@logistics-eu.com>
Date: 2026-07-22 08:30 +0100
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding - VAT evidence & invoice processing question

Thanks — confirming AP process:
- We will not change the PO amount. AP will post the invoice to the PO and create a VAT reversal entry so the supplier receives payment for the net amount.
- Required on invoice: supplier VAT number + wording that reverse charge applies. If VAT number is missing we will reject and return for correction (delay ~1 week).
- Banking: please ensure IBAN/SWIFT match the company extract and onboarding form. Any mismatch will cause a manual hold.

For the vendor agreement: Legal suggests a short addendum stating vendor agrees to comply with local VAT treatment and supply valid VAT registration numbers. Marissa, can Legal prepare a one-paragraph addendum for signature?

André — all good to proceed once the onboarding form is complete and uploaded. Expect the first payment in the next scheduled AP run after approval.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Finance Manager, AP
Redwood Inference
